notes.title: Texture color changes and gameplay modifications.
notes.notes: I decided to make changes to the color of textures in the game to create a more pleasant visual experience for the player. Additionally, I made modifications to the game mechanics by completely removing turrets, as I deemed them unnecessary.

notes.title: Update 0.2
notes.notes: 2 additional levels and a boss battle were added. Adding new units such as a helicopter that fires missiles. Also new mechanics - the use of dynamite to undermine obstacles
